name: Cycle steps (euler and trapezoidal)
plain: blepping's own steps that keep part of the predicted noise and replace the rest with fresh noise at every step, by a fixed share (cycle_pct, 0.25 by default). The trapezoidal form makes one extra call at the next sigma and blends the two guesses first.
math:
keep = 1 − c; add = √(σ'² − (keep·σ')²)·(0.95 + 0.25c).
x' = D + keep·(predicted noise) + add·ε.
